articles.summary: Yaw Bediako is an immunologist and the CEO of Yemaachi Biotech, an Accra-based immunogenomics company focused on diversifying precision oncology. Under his leadership, Yemaachi has positioned itself as a key contributor to African cancer research by leveraging the continent’s genetic diversity to identify novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets.
